measurementMethod: Editor PlayMode diagnostics are retained for named physics/controller/foundation timing only. Allocation qualification uses the standalone GAM9_ALLOC_DEV Development player. CPU/GPU acceptance uses the visible-window GAM9_PERF_RELEASE non-development Windows x64 player with UnityEngine.FrameTimingManager over actual rendered frames.

steadyStateGcOff.scope: Editor PlayMode frame; includes Unity Editor/Test Framework work and is not the release gate.

steadyStateGcTrace.scope: Editor PlayMode frame; includes Unity Editor/Test Framework work and is not the release gate.

allocationMetric: GC.Alloc in standalone GAM9_ALLOC_DEV Development player
editorAllocationGate: NOT_A_RELEASE_GATE; Unity Editor/PlayMode test-runner frame samples include harness allocations; standalone GC.Alloc evidence is required.
releaseAllocationGate: PASS; GAM9_ALLOC_DEV captured GC.Alloc over 120 warmed OFF and 120 warmed TRACE samples with max 0 bytes in both modes.
observationStorageContract: PASS; bounded preallocated storage, immutable slice views, stable 17-body ordering, current/previous exchange preserved, and no Rigidbody/GameObject references escape.
memoryBudgetBasis: Profiler.GetTotalAllocatedMemoryLong; Process.WorkingSet64 is unavailable in this Unity editor harness when reported as zero.
gpuMeasurement: GPU=NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_CURRENT_HARNESS; standalone graphics smoke is a separate gate.
staticHotPathAudit: PASS; CaptureObservation, PhysicsTickDriver.StepOne, and AttemptTrace.Append contain no managed arrays, LINQ/materialization, boxing, or string formatting.

standaloneRelease.gpuMeasurement: UnityEngine.FrameTimingManager.gpuFrameTime over the same actual rendered frames.
standaloneRelease.counterMeasurement: Unity.Profiling.ProfilerRecorder release-player counters captured per measured rendered frame; Draw Calls Count, Batches Count, SetPass Calls Count, Shadow Casters Count, and Visible Skinned Meshes Count.

invalidMeasurementExcluded: The hidden-window post-build sample was excluded because it reported zero render counters and unavailable GPU timing despite nominal CPU samples; it is not acceptance evidence.
